## Line-by-Line Analysis / 逐行分析

```c
1: for (int c0 = 1; c0 <= 11; c0 += 1) {
2:   for (int c1 = max(1, c0 - 3); c1 <= min(c0, -c0 + 8); c1 += 1)

9:   }
10:   for (int c1 = max(c0 - 3, -c0 + 13); c1 <= min(8, c0); c1 += 1)

14: }
```
